plugins.name: entrust
plugins.description: Run Codex as a subagent from Claude Code: rights declared per call, the network on by default at both levels and off by one line, exit codes derived from evidence, a receipt per completed turn. Adds an orchestration mode over Claude and Codex agents, an approved cleanup, an experiment mode that keeps its protocol and verdicts on record, a standing advisor and a swarm launcher.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Three skills you invoke to assess and improve any text: a README, code comments, an essay. `audit` finds where readers stumble and checks each claim against the code or facts behind it. `rethink` agrees what the text says and in what order before it is written. `rewrite` writes it: one writer who first works out who reads it, every critic at once, one repair and a check. Nothing touches your files without your word.
